name: Adversarial ID Decoupling
description: I explicitly warn the solver that employee IDs are assigned arbitrarily and that relying on numerical (chronological) order for depth-first search will lead to exponential dead ends. This breaks the LLM's heuristic assumption that searching in ID order is an efficient way to satisfy the lexicographic tie-breaker, forcing it to realize that naive DFS will TLE and it must use structural propagation first.
